purpose: Controlled Mainnet self-launch ordered-bundle qualification with two independent wallets and parallel builder fan-out

authorization.note: v1 remains historical; only this v2 contract may authorize the controlled self-launch test after explicit user approval
authorization.execution_authority: Only this v2 file may authorize the self-launch Mainnet send path; v1 is forbidden as runtime authority

scope.portal_rule: Reverify current Mainnet deployment/version/runtime code immediately before arming; mismatch is STOP
scope.launch_mode: controlled native-quote self-launch matching the intended harness, not the historical DOGE fixture
scope.buy: Direct Portal swapExactInput with native input and nonzero locally-derived minOutput
scope.historical_g03_authority: Historical DOGE/0.15-BNB G0.3 fixture is NOT authority for this native-quote self-launch; native mode requires its own dry semantic validation

wallet_separation.reason: Launch/BUY ordering must be proven by bundle semantics, not by same-sender nonce ordering
wallet_separation.secret_storage: No private key or secret is written to evidence

attempts.economic_attempt_definition: One self-launch plus one intended BUY. Parallel submission of byte-identical [launch_A,buy_B] bundle copies to multiple builders counts as ONE economic attempt.

bundle_bytes.max_block_window: At most send_head+2 unless a stricter provider-specific bound is available; never use a long default such as +100
bundle_bytes.expiry_mismatch: STOP if equivalent tight expiry cannot be expressed for every armed builder

fortyeightclub.rationale: N+1 qualification must not accept late-arriving bundle placement at the block tail.

min_output.source: Exact controlled post-launch state from the chosen native launch parameters
min_output.independent_cross_check: Local/offline independent sequential execution of exact launch_A then buy_B. Before authorization, exact valid Mainnet bytes MUST NOT be sent to external builder simulation endpoints.

gas_floor.policy: Before signing, determine the current acceptance floor/ranking rules for every armed builder. Use the strictest requirement for the identical transaction bytes.
gas_floor.blockrazor_current_documented_reference: 0.05 gwei average bundle gas price as of 2026-10-02 public support documentation
gas_floor.fortyeightclub: Do not reuse a stale universal 1-gwei assumption. Verify the current Puissant endpoint/validator acceptance and priority rule immediately before arming. Auction Feed/backrunTarget requirements are a separate scope from the controlled self-launch bundle.

bid_policy.stage_1: Bid through the signed transaction gas-price policy only; no separate automatic builder transfer/tip

budget_wei_proposal.note: Still PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Launch quoteAmt/value is fixed to 0 for this scope. The launch gas cap is the measured 2026-10-02 Mainnet eth_estimateGas 5,502,725 with a 120% reserve = 6,603,270. With buy gas cap 3,000,000 and max gas price 1 gwei, worst-case gas reserve is 0.00960327 BNB and total per-attempt reserve including the 0.001 BNB BUY is 0.01060327 BNB. Absolute four-attempt ceiling remains 0.05 BNB. Never increase these ceilings at runtime.

pre_arm_checks: Reverify current Flap Mainnet Portal/version/runtime code and selected native launch semantics
Validate exact native-mode launch->BUY transition independently; historical DOGE G0.3 fixture is insufficient
Resolve and freeze distinct launcher_A and buyer_B addresses and both pending nonces
Verify both wallets have sufficient balance under the proposed reserved worst-case budget without writing secrets to evidence
Compute positive minOutput locally from the exact self-launch parameters and cross-check with independent simulation
Validate exact signed raw launch and BUY transactions decode/recover to the intended sender, nonce, chain, portal, value, gas and calldata
Validate builder method/format/expiry semantics only with deliberately non-executable fixtures; exact valid Mainnet bytes remain local until authorization
Determine current builder gas-floor/ranking requirements; signed bytes must satisfy the strictest armed builder
Verify neither transaction is broadcast to the public mempool during dry qualification
Explicit user approval of this v2 scope and numeric absolute budget ceiling
Validate 48Club noMerge=true and positionFirst=true semantics using deliberately non-executable fixtures before arming.

success.acquisition: BUY receipt success plus positive intended-token balance delta at buyer_B with attributable economic debit/cost
success.ordering: Launch and BUY are in the same canonical block; BUY transaction index equals launch transaction index + 1; zero successful external BUYs between
success.builder_evidence: Record builder submission hash/status where exposed and identify block builder/validator where reliably attributable
success.timing: N+1 is ordering evidence only. T_buy-T0 remains UNKNOWN unless a trusted intra-block execution trace exists.

on_expiry_without_inclusion: Verify neither transaction appeared canonically or in the public mempool where observable
retention_observability.interpretation: Inclusion one or two blocks after submission is evidence relevant to bundle carry/re-simulation, but provider retention semantics must not be assumed solely from one successful inclusion.

thresholds.PASS: Controlled self-launch attempt acquires the token and produces same-block adjacent [launch_A@N,buy_B@N+1] ordering with zero successful external BUYs between, no public leakage, no budget/scope violation and complete evidence
thresholds.ADAPT: Bundle valid but not adjacent/same-block, builder rejected/outbid/expired, dry simulation divergence, or incomplete attribution without a safety violation
thresholds.STOP: Any scope/version mismatch, non-distinct wallets, zero/unverified minOutput, fee/floor uncertainty at arming, budget violation, nonce conflict, unexpected public broadcast, first revert, unresolved sent transaction, unexpected duplicate economic execution, or inability to prove expiration/non-execution safely

coverage.note: Coverage returns in the subsequent foreign-launch ingress qualification stage

required_checks: Runtime file path is exactly g01_mainnet_acceptance_proposal_v2.json
SHA-256 of exact v2 bytes equals the hash compiled/frozen into the armed harness
spent_budget_wei + reserved_worst_case_attempt_wei <= absolute approved total budget
attempt number does not exceed approved maximum
all Dry-PASS evidence predicates are true

criteria.pass: Both builder payload constructors contain the exact same raw_signed_launch_A bytes followed by the exact same raw_signed_buy_B bytes; independent transaction decoding and signature recovery yield distinct frozen wallet A and wallet B addresses, correct ChainID 56, nonces, Portal, value, gas and calldata.

A local/offline independent sequential execution of launch_A followed by buy_B succeeds, produces the same token address and exact received token amount as the local economics calculation, and signed minOutput is >0 and <= independently simulated received amount. Historical DOGE fixture values are not reused as authority.

Current acceptance/ranking gas-floor semantics for every armed builder are independently verified before signing; identical signed bytes satisfy the strictest verified requirement. Independent simulated gas for launch and BUY, multiplied by the signed gas price and combined with launch value, BUY value and any allowed builder cost, fits both the per-attempt reserve and absolute approved budget.

Bundle expiry/maxBlock fields are within the approved tight window, launcher and buyer pending nonces match the signed transactions, and an egress guard proves zero bytes of the valid signed launch, valid signed BUY, or valid bundle payload were written to any socket/process/stdout/file intended for network transmission before authorization.

dry_pass.provider_prequalification: Builder method/format/expiry behavior before authorization may only use deliberately non-executable fixtures. Exact valid Mainnet transaction/bundle bytes must not be sent to a remote simulation endpoint before authorization.
